_comment: Switched on in report mode 2026-09-16 (founder decision). Modes: 'report' (the default when the file exists) computes and surfaces every verdict but never holds a wake back — use it to see the threshold against real traffic first; 'enforce' actually defers a wake until its cooldown elapses. Deleting the file returns to 'off'. A deferred wake is NOT a failure: it keeps its retry budget and is reconsidered after the cooldown. 'manual' and 'recovery' wakes are never throttled, so a founder action and crash recovery stay immediate. See docs/software-factory/PAPERCLIP_REWAKE_THROTTLE.md.
